# HuffPost

> > HuffPost is a progressive digital news platform delivering breaking news, political analysis, and opinion journalism with coverage of the Trump administration, congressional affairs, and national security issues.

HuffPost provides comprehensive reporting on U.S. politics, international conflicts, and social issues, with particular focus on the Republican Party, defense policy, and investigative journalism. The platform emphasizes secure source protection and anonymous whistleblowing through SecureDrop.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- Pete Hegseth
- Trump Administration
- U.S. Politics
- Breaking News
- Republican Party (GOP)
- Iran Conflict
- Defense Secretary
- Vladimir Putin
- Fox News
- Investigative Journalism
- SecureDrop
- Source Protection
- Military News
- Current Events

## Main Site

- [HuffPost - Breaking News, Politics, Entertainment & Opinion](https://www.huffpost.com/): Homepage featuring breaking news on Trump, Hegseth, Putin, and politics

## News & Analysis

- [Police Officers, Sheriffs, Rangers, and Marshals: What's the Difference?](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/police-officers-sheriffs_b_7835320): Explainer on US law enforcement types: police, sheriffs, Texas Rangers

## Source Protection & Tips

- [How To Share Information With HuffPost](https://tips.huffpost.com/): Secure tips submission guide using SecureDrop and Tor Browser
